name: Dolanaar Delivery
summary: In Shadowglen, fresh herbs are bound for Dolanaar. Porthannius entrusts the bundle to young travelers for Innkeeper Keldamyr.

sections.title: A Bundle from Shadowglen
sections.body: Fresh herbs gathered in Aldrassil must reach Dolanaar. Porthannius is occupied with the druids of Shadowglen, so he gives the bundle to young travelers heading south along the road. They carry it to Innkeeper Keldamyr.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hearth
sections.body: At Dolanaar's inn, Keldamyr receives the parcel with gratitude. The inn offers weary travelers rest, peace of mind, and sanctuary before they venture deeper into Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is inside the Dolanaar Delivery?
faq.answer: The package holds fresh herbs gathered in Shadowglen for Innkeeper Keldamyr and Dolanaar's inn patrons.
Porthannius prepares the bundle while tending to business with the druids in Shadowglen. He cannot spare the time to travel south himself.

faq.q: Who receives the package in Dolanaar?
aliases: who do i bring the herbs to
faq.answer: Innkeeper Keldamyr receives the package at Dolanaar's communal inn.

faq.q: Why couldn't Porthannius deliver the parcel himself?
faq.answer: Porthannius is occupied with unfinished business among the druids around Aldrassil. So he seeks a traveler heading south along the forest road.

angles.text: Herbs gathered around Aldrassil are in steady demand as Teldrassil's outlying settlements stock their supplies.
As a young kaldorei, you carry the package beyond Shadowglen's protective boughs and into the wider realm.
